title: MX Component Library
description: A comprehensive, enterprise-grade React component library built for Mendix applications. Ships 60+ production-ready components with full Atlas UI token integration, Figma design sync, and end-to-end TypeScript support.
features: Tree-shakeable components with zero runtime overhead
Full TypeScript support with rich IntelliSense
Mendix-native theming with Atlas design tokens
WCAG 2.1 AA accessible out of the box
Built-in Storybook integration & docs
Live preview with hot-reload in Mendix Studio Pro
problemSolved: Standard Mendix layouts require repetitive frontend coding. The MX Component Library bridges Design System Tokens (Figma) and developer implementation in Mendix, enforcing accessibility and styling automatically at scale.

title: Dynamic Data Grid
description: Advanced data grid for Mendix with virtual scrolling, inline editing, dynamic column sorting, and custom cell renders. Built for low latency rendering of 100K+ records.
features: Virtual rendering handles 100,000+ data rows at 60fps
Custom inline editing cells with validation
Excel-like column resizing, freezing, and sorting
Full integration with Mendix database microflows
problemSolved: Default Mendix grids lag when rendering large financial datasets. The Dynamic Data Grid uses virtual scrolling optimization to keep performance smooth under massive loads.

title: Design Token Manager
description: Figma plugin to manage, sync, and export design tokens directly to CSS, Tailwind, and Mendix Atlas UI formats, closing the designer-developer gap.
features: One-click sync to GitHub repository files
Multi-theme token switching (Light/Dark themes)
Supports typography, sizing, colors, and shadow sets
Exports directly to Mendix Atlas UI design tokens
problemSolved: Design system updates often lead to manual variable copy-pasting. The Token Manager automates theme overrides directly from Figma styles into the developers' SCSS build steps.

title: AI Layout Assist
description: AI-powered layout suggestion engine for Mendix Studio Pro. Analyzes page context and recommends responsive grid alignments and accessibility tags.
features: Scans page structure and suggests WCAG landmarks
Resolves responsive grid bugs with auto-fixes
Generates layout drafts from natural language prompts
problemSolved: Creating complex responsive layouts in low-code is error-prone. AI Layout Assist provides real-time layout guidelines to ensure responsive layouts comply with enterprise standards.

title: Smart Rating
description: Mendix Pluggable Rating Widget featuring custom star assets, fractional scoring, micro-interactions, keyboard accessibility, and hover indicators.
features: Fractional rating supports (e.g. 3.5 stars rendering)
Screen reader friendly labels and keyboard inputs
Custom rating scales (5 stars, 10 stars, emojis)
problemSolved: Default low-code rating inputs lack modern hover animations and fine-grained fractional support needed for professional reviews dashboards.

title: File Preview Pro
description: Enterprise pluggable file workspace. Renders PDF, images, audio, and documents inline with approval workflows and version comparisons directly in Mendix pages.
features: Secure client-side document rendering in sandbox iframe
Annotations tool for direct overlay reviews
Side-by-side version comparison tools
problemSolved: Downloading large files to preview them breaks audit safety constraints. File Preview Pro keeps files secure on server-side nodes while delivering fast UI previews.

title: Future AI Plugin
description: An upcoming smart assistant integration plugin. Close-range automated token generation based on drawing patterns in Figma designs.

title: Component Marketplace
description: A secure store widget for downloading and purchasing custom react modules directly inside the Mendix dashboard view.
